objective: One RGB-D-selected native-connected brick grasp and straight withdrawal; no transfer/classification/placement claim.
history: Closed idle/contact/proxy/query benchmarks remain closed and all failures preserved. Original1778 global G remains failed at distal axial endcap; current model is authorized only for lateral-qualified flat-face contacts. D1791/R1794 establish bounded normal-contact/reopen, not tangential retention or extraction.

cases.requires: Independent I pass and frozen implementation; no reserved-driven changes

budget.round_policy: Baseline then at most three separately reviewed changes, each addressing one observed development failure; no automatic alternatives. Reserved is evaluated once after retained development success. Existing closed pools are not reset. No speedup/coarsening on timeout.

physics.native_thresholds: Unchanged exact frozen exposed-tip benchmark values
physics.mass_route: Validated two exact count1 finger RigidBodyViews; masses L/R then COM L/R then inertias L/R, strict all-six whole-robot readback; no nonfinger setters
physics.cook_identity: Reuse exact single-body/head cook export and canonical vertex/normalized-plane fingerprint, no global queries/new model or tuning

stationary_guard.scope: Matched full-duration stationary source control; not a grasp validation.

perception.pose_frame: TABLE: source plate center origin,+X gray plate,+Y bowl,+Z up; not robot base
perception.camera_status: Configured fixed virtual RGB-D inspection camera; no physical D435/wrist calibration claim
perception.candidate_selection: Among PRESENT candidates with all support/uncertainty-inflated clearance checks passing, minimize planar distance from current measured TCP; tie by opaque candidate_id. Select once before motion; no truth matching or alternative target after failure.
perception.height: Use locally supported upper depth surface from the selected opaque RGB-D neighborhood; coarse R3 band median alone is not a certified body-top. Account for known1.7mm stud/body difference when checking nominal body-side overlap. Unsupported/ambiguous depth abstains.
perception.unknown_or_abstention: Counts as failed coverage for this case, not a successful pick or permission to fill from simulator truth.

geometry_safety_view.calibration_policy: Fixed original full-design reference center and unchanged focal/aperture/resolution; no target or current-state camera recentering. Configured virtual view only.
geometry_safety_view.capture_policy: Close RGB-D first for unchanged R3. Wide RGB-D at identical physics time, then restore close pose. Geometry only.
geometry_safety_view.clearance_policy: Identical sampled points/envelopes/proprio self-skip. Each nonself sample requires strict positive measured depth gap in at least one valid view; otherwise abstain. Unknown remains unknown in each view.

engineering_envelopes.meaning: Explicit simulation engineering working bounds, not calibrated covariance or guarantees. Combine pose, TCP tracking and rotational swept extents, rather than testing each in isolation.
engineering_envelopes.unknown_depth: No corridor fill from CAD layout, GT poses or missing depth. Unsupported inflated finger/metal/head swept volume abstains.

tool_frames.grip_axis: Hand X along observed brick long axis; opening hand Y across short axis; hand Z distal/down opposite observed upright top normal.
tool_frames.online_clearance: Inflate actual known body/white/head tool envelope by the combined engineering bounds. No ghosting or contact-permitted descent on unsupported corridors.
tool_frames.physical_mount_status: User-confirmed orientation/proximal alignment, nominal rigid attachment; no physical fit calibration.

motion.finger_initialization: Configure preopening once before measurement; no target brick or robot pose writes after initialization
motion.grasp_action: Stop closing and hold joint targets; not a claimed regulated-force controller
motion.force_abort_semantics: SUM ABS of all finite normal coefficients on each finger, all partners; sampled abort, not a guaranteed cap
motion.joint_position_limits: Actual asset joint limits; any violation or nonfinite stops
motion.completion: Controller follows bounded sensor-derived waypoints and force trigger; native detachment never advances the online phase.

controller.implementation: Installed IsaacLab DifferentialIKController, ik_method dls; existing challenge2/env_cfg.py Actions.arm is configuration precedent, not a validated arm-trajectory result
controller.pose_and_jacobian_frame: Actual robot-root frame for both linear and angular blocks
controller.TCP_jacobian: J_linear_world=J_hand_linear_world-skew(R_world_hand*offset_hand)@J_hand_angular_world; then rotate BOTH blocks by inverse actual root quaternion
controller.TCP_pose: Actual measured hand link pose composed with rotated updated hand-to-grip offset, then transformed to actual root frame. Do not copy the old stock0.1034m TCP or unrotated offset shortcut.

contacts.scope: Simulation-only per-finger contact instrumentation, not hardware force-sensor equivalence
contacts.online_inputs: Unlabelled aggregate finger normal/friction data, world contact points/normals/separations and proprioception. Actor/collider IDs/filter labels stripped before controller; full raw data retained offline.
contacts.normal_scalar_semantics: Preserve signed f*n vectors and SUMABS magnitudes
contacts.pad_outward: -sign(f)*n for finger view; +sign(f)*n for reciprocal reporting, mapped with actual finger frame. Never fit/try sign flips.
contacts.load_domain: ALL force-carrying points must be uniquely body compatible, flat inward-Y compatible and laterally qualified; no Z exclusion. Cap/taper/head/white/unassociated loads stop. Cosine0.9 is not exact zero axial force.
contacts.contact_association: Only spatial compatibility with the sensor-selected candidate envelope; no GT actor-path selection or exemption.
contacts.friction: Retain raw separate friction anchor/count/vector buffers; tangential load is measured during this trial. No friction calibration or invented wrist-wrench estimator.
contacts.native_truth: Logged only for initialization/evaluation; not controller input.
contacts.evaluation_only_source_view: Uniquely bound once by initial selected-image face versus initial GT projection. Raw view and identity remain evaluation-only; never controller input or phase/target selection.

independent_evaluation.identity_binding: Before motion, evaluator uniquely binds the frozen selected RGB-D face to one GT brick; ambiguous binding fails. Binding never enters controller.
independent_evaluation.detachment: Selected target becomes a singleton native component disconnected from all source/plate parts; every broken edge must be incident to that prebound target, no unrelated breaks
forbidden_success_shortcuts: No deallocate_connection or create_connection during manipulation
No truth-selected source drift exclusion online
independent_evaluation.physics_extraction_and_online_hold_verif: Report separately; RGB-D held association may be UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN blocks transfer/stacking even if independent physics extraction passes.
independent_evaluation.watchdog: Experiment-side nonfinite/catastrophic-state stop is separate from online task logic, never a native-completion signal.

stop_policy: First unsupported sensor corridor, unbound candidate, DLS tracking/joint/speed limit, force/contact-domain violation, nonfinite or exhausted step/wall budget stops with preserved evidence. No target substitution/reset/teleport completion; no transfer after uncertain held identity.

implementation_support_rules.clearance_reference: Pointwise combined XY/Z/yaw/TCP engineering envelopes at each box corner/midplane; observed ray-space free checks and known-proprioceptive current tool self volume only; unknown fails. No GT scene completion or global collision-certification claim.
